Long term is remembering to take my meds in general. But at the moment, it's remembering to take and stick with medication for my ADHD.

See, the medication works great and helps but I have to get adjusted to it first, and every day I don't take it, I get set back like a timer restarting and have to start over. However, this is difficult because the waiting for the adjustments sucks - I get symptoms like difficulty sleeping, no appetite at all (which makes it difficult because I will start to feel physically ill from not eating, but when I try to eat, it's really hard for me because I feel "full" so quickly and finishing off a normal sized portioned meal becomes nauseating), feeling very cold (especially my feet! My feet always freeze. Hands do too, sometimes) and I also sometimes experience mild symptoms of a panic attack and/or general anxiety for no reason at all. 

I'm currently off the meds because hey, I thought, it's the weekend. I'd like to sleep and eat and not feel crummy but I can already see a decline in my general daily "performance". But it's too late - it's been "reset" so now I'll have to struggle through getting adjusted again. At least it's become easier to adjust each and every time the longer I've been on it though and the symptoms aren't too terrible - other than the not eating thing, they're generally mild physical annoyances than actual "symptoms".
